data.name: LongStory
data.detailed_description:
LongStory 2 Launch Date

Are you ready for more LongStory drama? The next installment of this beloved series brings more dates, deeper friendships, trickier dilemmas, and some fascinating surprises!


Acerca do jogo

Who ever said you can't go back?

LongStory, a charming and LGBTQ+ friendly dating sim set at the weirdly lovable Weasel Heights Middle School lets you pick your pronouns as well as who, or even if, you would like to date any of your romanceable friends.



On your first day of school you discover that the previous owner of your locker has “mysteriously” disappeared. Do you want to figure out what happened or are you too busy being a social butterfly and trying to avoid your enemies…

LongStory gives you a chance to find true love as a middle school student (yes with all the awkwardness that entails) but we promise it will be so much better this time around!




Episode 1 Locker 1224: Being a new student at Weasel Heights, you’ve got enough on your plate trying to make new friends and deal with enemies but what happened to the previous owner of locker 1224 and why won't anyone talk about it?

Episode 2 Hanna's Notebook: Things are getting serious with your crush but watch out there is some real Drama with Hanniferjane do you want to get involved with that? What will your crush think?

Episode 3 The Party: The Party: Middle School dances are a big deal, who do you go with? Do you bring your crush or show up without a date? Things at Weasel Heights are never what they seem. It's time to learn more about your friend Colin and his big secret.

Episode 4 Drama: A “new” student is back at Weasel Heights and it's causing all sorts of drama, no matter what you do it doesn’t seem like you can stay out of it. Friendships and relationships are strained, will you be okay?

Episode 5 Make Up: Not every relationship is perfect. It's time to step up and make things right with your friends. Maybe even take the highroad and reach out to those you consider enemies.

Episode 6 History: Middle school friendships and relationships are hard. Attend the intense but informative “Healthy Relationships Workshop.” and maybe the adults will know what they are talking about… for once.

Episode 7 Onward and Awkward: As your final year winds down it's time to choose what high school you will go to. How do you decide? Most importantly how will the TurkeyHawk?

data.short_description: In LongStory you can be and date who you choose. Play as the gender of your choice and date the cutie you like best! LongStory is is based on real stories - things that have happened, if not to us, to people we know and love. We hope it is funny, sad, perplexing and wonderful… Just like life.

reviews.review:
LongStory has some decent ideas when it comes to, well, story. The bullying aspect of high school definitely rang true, and the online relationship with Nora was very similar to the internet relationship I'm actually having. Unfortunately everything built around the story is lacking in a way that means I can't recommend a purchase in its current state.

LongStory was initially designed for a mobile platform, and it definitely shows. No sound effects, no text skip, and an extremely clunky 'episode' system that means one wrong choice can force you to give up half an hour of progress. Some of the decisions I had to make were two options I never wanted to select (blabbing about the secrets of someone who's sworn you to privacy, where there's no third option to keep quiet). A lack of transitions and repetitive music make the pacing very uncomfortable at times, and a complete lack of internal dialogue/narration causes the text to feel clunky (especially whenever it's describing what the TurkeyHawk does).

If it was a more competent port better designed for PC, I might've been willing to stick with this game for longer. As it is though, I don't think I have the patience for it.
